turns.q: Once it ships, how long is delivery?
turns.replyTail:
delivery usually takes about 5–7 business days to arrive at your home.
A couple things can affect timing:
Nationwide deliveries may take around 9–14 days total to reach the local hub before scheduling.
Some items (like rugs) can take 2–6 weeks after shipping.
So after it leaves the warehouse, most deliveries arrive within about a week.

If your tracking shows “delivered” but you didn’t receive the package, try these steps:
Check around your home (front door, side entrances, package lockers, etc.).
Confirm the delivery address used at checkout to make sure it’s correct.
Contact the shipping carrier listed on your tracking and file a missing package claim using your tracking number.
Also note: sometimes “delivered” can mean the package reached a local carrier hub or was handed to a third‑party carrier, not that it has arrived at your home yet.
